CHAPTER 6 · ITEM 10 / 12

Unit taxes and incidence

Per-unit tax burden每單位稅負

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Calculate the buyer's per-unit burden Pb − P0 and seller's per-unit burden P0 − Ps, where P0 is the original price; the burdens sum to the tax.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

買方每件負擔 Pb−P0，賣方每件負擔 P0−Ps，合計為 t。要算交易單位上的總負擔，再乘稅後數量。

Compare each post-tax price with the original equilibrium P0. Buyers bear Pb−P0, sellers bear P0−Ps, and these add to t. Total burdens across traded units multiply these amounts by the post-tax quantity.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：P0=100, Pb=120, Ps=90. Buyers bear 20 and sellers 10; total unit tax=30. 買方負擔三分之二。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

P0=50, Pb=56, Ps=46. Seller's burden per unit? 賣方每件負擔？
